name: Serpentfolk, Psionic
body:
SERPENTFOLK, PSIONIC
CR 4

XP 1,200
NE Medium monstrous humanoid (psionic)
Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+5 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 42 (5d10+15)
Fort +4, Ref +9, Will +6
Immune mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison; PR 15

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk dagger +11 (1d4–1/19–20), bite +5 (1d6–1 plus poison)
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 4th; concentration +7)

At will—control sound (DC 15), minor metamorphosis *
1/day—compelling voice (DC 15), concealing amorpha, sense minds (DC 15)

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 21, Con 17, Int 18, Wis 15, Cha 16
Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 19
Feats Improved Initiative, Psionic Endowment, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +10, Disguise +8, Escape Artist +18, Knowledge (arcana) +9, Knowledge (history) +9, Perception +10, Sense Motive +7, Spellcraft +9; Racial Modifiers +8 Escape Artist
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic, Undercommon; telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 15; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str; cure 2 saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ABOUT

As they closely resemble their magical kin, it is thought by many that the transformation from ophiduan to serpentfolk attempts to repress or innoculate the qlippoth corruption within a scaled psionicist. Though nothing appears unusual about a psionic serpentfolk, the being’s internal workings are actually reconfigured to take full advantage of their corruption-elevated mental potential. A psionic serpentfolk’s body seems to be constantly shifting and restructuring as if experimenting for an optimal arrangement.
